choice.basis: The chart's plotted data is the authoritative evidence source. The blue line for 'New Tourists' starts at the 1,000 mark on the y-axis in 1880 and ends at a value between 2,500 and 3,000 (approx. 2,700) in 1891. This indicates a net increase in new tourists over the review period, despite the chart title's contradictory label of 'Decreasing'.
